<head-word>גְּנִינִים, </head-word>

<pos> m. pl.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (contr. of גַּוְונוּנ', v. 
<xref rid="C00335">גַּוָּון</xref>) 
<italic>of many colors</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Nidd. III, 3 (24
<sup>b</sup>) שפיר מלא גנו' (an abortion consisting of) a bag full of a many-colored substance; (Ar. גני'—for which in Gem. ib. גוונים; incorr. opin. = גבנונים 
<italic>lumps of a fleshy substance</italic>, v. Ar. s. v.); Bekh. VIII, 1 גנו' (Talm. ed. 47
<sup>b</sup> גני'); Kerith. I, 5 גנו' (Talm. ed. 7
<sup>b</sup> גני').—Esp. 
<italic>a sort of flour containing all shades of colors</italic>. Tanḥ. T’savveh 13 סאה גני' (ed. Bub. 10 גבונים, Ms. R. גנינין, oth. corrupt. v. ib. note 63) one measure full of all sorts of flour; Y. Peah VII, 20
<sup>a</sup> bot. גניינן (corr. גנינין; omitted in Yalk. Hab. 565).—Sot. 36
<sup>b</sup> גְּנוּנֵי מלכות royal 
<italic>manners</italic> (v. גַּוָּון a. גַּוָּונָא; Ar. גִּנוּסֵי, גְּנִיסֵי, v. גִּינִיסְיָא).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C01161">
<head-word>גַּס, </head-word>
<hw-number>III</hw-number>
<head-word>גַּסָּה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (גסס, cmp. גשש) 
<italic>bulky, huge, large</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. III, 1 עוף הגס large fowl (goose, hen &c.), opp. דק.—(בהמה)גסה 
<italic>large cattle</italic> (beeves &c.), opp. דקה sheep, goats &c. Ib. Y. Pes. IV, 30
<sup>d</sup> bot.; a. fr.—Dem. II, 4 sq. במדה ג', בגסה in large quantities, 
<italic>wholesale</italic>.—Ber. 6
<sup>b</sup> פסיעה ג' large, hasty step. Pes. 107
<sup>b</sup> אכילה ג' a large, full meal.—Shebi. IV, 1 (to gather wood or stones) את הגס הגס the larger the better, i.e. picking out the largest for using them in buildings &c., clearly indicating that it is not done for the purpose of improving the field; expl. Y. ib. beg. 35
<sup>a</sup> כדרך שהוא מלקט … בין דקים לגסים as one gathers in his neighbor’s field distinguishing between the small and large pieces.—Nidd. 2
<sup>b</sup> הַגַּס הַגַּס she noticed the menstruation only when coming in large quantities (in clods, while the blood had previously been imperceptibly gathering).—
<plural-form>Pl. גַּסִּים, גַּסִּין,</plural-form> f. גַּסּוֹת. Y. Shebi. l. c. Ḥag. 26
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—גַּס רוּחַ 
<italic>presumptuous, haughty.</italic> Ab. IV, 7. [Ib. גס לבו, v. גּוּס.]—
<plural-form>Pl. גַּסֵּי רוח</plural-form>. Y. Pes. V, 32
<sup>a</sup> bot.; a. fr.—גַּסִּים (sub. נקבים) 
<italic>movement of the bowels</italic>, v. גָּדוֹל end. Y. Ber. II, 4
<sup>d</sup> top; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<notes> Der. Er. Zutta ch. V ולא יִגְסֶה בפני וכ' must not eat or drink like a glutton in the presence of &c.—Pesik. Vattomer, p. 131
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to לחם הקלקל, Num. XXI, 5) I (the Lord) selected for them light food …, שלא יהא אחד מהם גּוֹסֶה ודלריא אחזתו lest one of them should eat too much and be seized with diarrhœa; Sifré Deut. 1 Ms. (v. ed. Fr. note 26); Yalk. Num. 764 גוטי (corr. acc.); ib. Deut. 790 גוסרודליא (read גוס' ודולריא); ib. Is. 332 גוטס (corr. acc.); Lam. R. to III, 37 גּוֹסֵא.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to feel inflated, nauseous; to belch</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Nidd. 63
<sup>b</sup> (among the symptoms of approaching menstruation) וגוֹסָה.—V. גּוֹסִי.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<head-word>גַּסְטְרָא</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>

<italic>military camp, fort</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 121
<sup>a</sup> אנשי ג' של וכ' Ar. (ed. גיסט', גיסת', גיזט', v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> the Roman garrison of Sepphoris. Ber. 32
<sup>b</sup> (Ms. M. גיסט', Yalk. Is. 332 גסתרא) ועל כל לגיון ולגיון בראתי בו שלשים ג' וכ' Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) for each legion (of minor planets in the constellations) I created thirty camps, and for each camp thirty squares, v. קרטון.</definition>
<notes>—Sot. 13
<sup>b</sup> sq. שלחה מלכות הרשעה אצל ג' בית וכ' the Roman government sent to the camp of Beth Peor; (Yalk. Deut. end גיס'; Pesik. Zutr. Deut. p. 134 מלכות של חצרה ושל בית וכ').—Hence: pr. n. pl. 
<italic>Castra</italic>. Lev. R. s. 23 כגון ג' לחיפא as Castra is hostile to Haifa; Lam. R. to I, 17 קסטרא.—
<plural-form>Pl. גַּסְטְרָיוֹת</plural-form>. Gen. R. s. 28 אריות ג'; Yalk. ib. 47 חיילות גי', read אהליות וג', v. אָהֳלִית.—</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>*2)</number>
<definition> (cmp. castellum) 
<italic>reservoir</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 15 Ar., Var. קִנְצְטְרָא (cisterna, κινστέρνα) 
<italic>cistern</italic> (not extant in ed; B. Bath. 16

Snh. 96
<sup>b</sup>; Gitt. 57
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—ג' שקר an insincere proselyte (from impure motives). Y. B. Mets. V, 10
<sup>c</sup>.—

<sup>a</sup>; a. e.—גרי אריות

<sup>b</sup>, opp. גרי אמת. Kidd. 75
<sup>b</sup>; Snh. 85
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—גרי חלומות proselytes converted by the advice of a dreamer or an interpreter of dreams; גרי מרדכי ואסתר such as joined the Jewish ranks from motives like those prevalent in the days of Mordecai and Esther (Esth. VIII, 17). Yeb. 24
<sup>b</sup>.—Nidd. VII, 3 (56
<sup>b</sup>) גרים טועין Ar. (ed. וטועין) proselytes not living in accordance with the Jewish usages.—בן גרים a descendant of proselytes. B. Mets. IV, 10 (58
<sup>b</sup>).—Sabb. 33
<sup>b</sup> יהודה בן ג'. [Mode of admission, v. Yeb. 47
<sup>a</sup>.—Views about converts, v. Num. R. s. 8; Nidd. 13
<sup>b</sup>; Pes. 87
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.]. Fem. גֵּרָה. Gen. R. s. 88, end.—Usu. גִּיֹּורֶת. Keth. IV, 3; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
